n-k-k6-02.title: Ngawaphi amaqela anokungena?
n-k-k6-02.topic: Imithetho yokufunda enemida: amaqela, ubungakanani nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali
n-k-k6-02.goal: Funda isaziso sokungena esineemithetho ekhawulelana, wakhe amaqela amaninzi anelisa yonke imithetho ngaxeshanye, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni uhlobo olunye lweqela lungenakusebenza.
n-k-k6-02.material:
Iklabhu yakho ifuna ukutyelela imyuziyam yesayensi yabantwana. Ufunda isaziso uze ugqibe ngohlahlo-lwabiwo mali.

[어린이 과학관 단체 입장 안내]
- 요금: 어른 한 명 5,000원, 어린이 한 명 3,000원
- 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다. 어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지 들어갈 수 있습니다.
- 단체 입장은 모두 5명 이상일 때만 가능합니다.
- 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다.

Uhlahlo-lwabiwo mali lweklabhu yakho: 총 요금 25,000원 이하.
n-k-k6-02.thinking.0: Ukuguqula amagama enani esiKorea abe ziimeko
n-k-k6-02.thinking.2: Ukubona indlela umthetho omnye ohambisa omnye
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.prompt: Jonga kuphela umthetho ngabadala nabantwana (ungakhathali ngexabiso nemithetho yobungakanani beqela). Sesiphi isityelelo ESINGAVUNYELWANGA?
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funda '어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지' njengomthetho osetyenziswa kumntu omdala ngamnye ngokwahlukeneyo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, phindaphinda inani labantu abadala ngabantwana abavunyelweyo uze uthelekise.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.b: Kuvunyelwe: umntu omdala omnye angazisa ukuya kubantwana abathathu, kwaye uthathu ngumda ngokwawo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.c: Kuvunyelwe: abantu abadala ababini bangazisa ukuya kubantwana abathandathu.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.d: Kuvunyelwe: abantu abadala abane bangazisa ukuya kubantwana abalishumi elinesibini.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.explain: Umda ngabantwana abathathu KUMNTU OMDALA ngamnye. Abantu abadala ababini bangazisa ubuninzi be-2 x 3 = 6 abantwana, ngoko abasixhenxe baninzi kakhulu.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.prompt: Yakha amaqela angama-3 ahlukeneyo anelisa YONKE imithetho nohlahlo-lwabiwo mali. a = inani labantu abadala, c = inani labantwana.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala iimeko ezine ngamazwi akho kuqala (abantu abadala, abantwana ngomntu omdala ngamnye, abantu bonke, imali).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha kuqala inani labantu abadala, uze ufumane ukuba ngamangaphi amanani abantwana avunyelwe ngumthetho wesilinganiselo nomthetho wabantu abayi-5.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.2: Khangela imali ekugqibeleni: 5,000 x abantu abadala + 3,000 x abantwana.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Sebenzisa amanani aphelele abantu (0 okanye abantwana abangakumbi).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다: ubuncinane umntu omdala omnye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Akungabikho abantwana abangaphezu kwabathathu ngomntu omdala ngamnye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Abantwana abaninzi kakhulu: ubuninzi abathathu kumntu omdala ngamnye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c3: 단체 입장은 5명 이상: ubuncinane abantu abayi-5 bebonke.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c5: 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다: ubuncinane umntwana omnye.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo abantu abadala aba-2 + abantwana aba-3 = 19,000 won; 3 + 2 = 21,000 won; 4 + 1 = 23,000 won. Amaqela amathandathu ayafaneleka zizonke: (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (3,2), (3,3), (4,1). Isaziso sinika imida, hayi iqela elinye elichanekileyo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Zama iqela elinomntu omdala OMNYE kanye. Kwizivakalisi ezi-1 okanye ezi-2 (isiNgesi okanye isiKorea), chaza ukuba kutheni akukho qela linjalo linokwanelisa imithetho. Sebenzisa amanani.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bala abona bantu baninzi eqela elinomntu omdala omnye anokuba nabo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Thelekisa eli nani nomthetho wobungakanani beqela.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ndisebenzise umda wabantwana aba-3 kunye nobuncinane babantu abayi-5 kunye?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba amanani am anokusebenza nakubantu abadala aba-2?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngomntu omdala o-1, ubuninzi abantwana aba-3 banokuza, ngoko iqela linabantu aba-4 kuphela, kodwa ubuncinane abayi-5.

n-k-k6-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda inxalenye nganye, ukhethe indlela yokufunda ebonakala inokwenzeka kakhulu, uze uqhubeke.
n-k-k6-05.title: Ngaba wayenzile umsebenzi wasekhaya?
n-k-k6-05.topic: Ukungacaci kumyalezo: 다 + 안 inokuthetha 'akukho' okanye 'hayi yonke'
n-k-k6-05.goal: Funda incoko emfutshane ngamanqanaba, ubone ukuba 'ㅡ 다 안 했어요' inokuthetha izinto ezimbini, ulungise ukufunda njengoko kufika iinkcukacha, ubhale izivakalisi ezicacileyo.
n-k-k6-05.material: Utitshala ubuza ngomsebenzi wasekhaya. Umsebenzi wasekhaya ubunemiba eli-10.
n-k-k6-05.thinking.0: Ukubamba iindlela ezimbini zokufunda isivakalisi esinye
n-k-k6-05.thinking.1: Ukulungisa indlela yokufunda xa kufika iinkcukacha ezintsha
n-k-k6-05.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona umyalezo ukuze ungaqondwa gwenxa
n-k-k6-05.prereq.0: Uyayazi 안 + isenzi kunye ne-못 + isenzi
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nquma usebenzisa kuphela oko ukufundileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, uze uthi ngokuvakalayo yonke intsingiselo isivakalisi esinokuba nayo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuba zeziphi iintsingiselo ezisahambelana emva kokongeza imigca emitsha.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Zozibini iindlela zokufunda ziyenzeka: '다 안 했어요' inokuthetha 'akenzanga nanye' okanye 'akenzanga yonke'. '죄송해요' ibonisa ukuba kukho into engekhoyo, kodwa hayi ukuba kungakanani.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uxolisa ('죄송해요'), into engahambelaniyo nokuba ugqibe yonke into.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho nto kwimigca ekhankanya enye iklasi.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngoku '숙제를 다 안 했어요' ibithetha ntoni?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Iinkcukacha zisigqibile: kwenziwe imiba eyi-8 kweli-10, ngoko isivakalisi sasithetha 'hayi yonke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthi wenze imiba ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-8.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wenze uninzi lwawo waphoswa yimiba emibini yokugqibela.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Impendulo yakhe yesibini ichaza ngqo ukuba yeyiphi imiba ayenzileyo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sesiphi isivakalisi 유나 ekufuneka asibhale ukuze utitshala angasiqondi gwenxa njengokuthi 'wenze uninzi lwawo'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '하나도 안 했어요' ayishiyi ndawo ye'nxalenye'. '다는 못 했어요' yeyona ndlela icacileyo yokuthi 'hayi yonke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Esi sisivakalisi esinye esinemiphumo emibini njengangaphambili; asisibeki bucala 'wenze inxalenye'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Esi sivakala ngathi 'wenze inxalenye kodwa hayi yonke', ngokuchaseneyo noko 유나 afuna ukukuthetha.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela ukuba amagama afanayo ahlala enjalo kwaye ziinkcukacha kuphela eziguqule indlela oyifunda ngayo. Isithethi esifuna ukuqiniseka ukuba siyaqondwa kufuneka sikhethe amagama avumela intsingiselo enye kuphela.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.prompt: Zeziphi ezi zivakalisi zinokungaqondwa kakuhle ngendlela efanayo ne-'숙제를 다 안 했어요'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Fumana isivakalisi apho igama elithetha 'yonke' ahlangana khona negama elingalayo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukuthi isivakalisi ngasinye ucinga iimeko ezimbini ezahlukileyo ubone ukuba yeyiphi ehambelana nazozibini.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.b: Esi sithi iindwendwe azikafiki; asinakwahlulwa kwi'yonke okanye akukho'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.c: Esi sithi ngokucacileyo akukho namnye ofikileyo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.d: Esi sithi bambalwa abafikileyo; asishiyi 'akukho okanye hayi bonke' kuvulekile.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.explain: '다' (yonke) elandelwa ngokungalayo inokufundwa njengo'akukho' okanye 'hayi yonke', ngoko '손님이 다 안 왔어요' inazo iindlela ezimbini zokufunda ezifanayo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.prompt: Bhala izivakalisi ezibini zesiKorean (intetho ehloniphekileyo), enye nganye imalunga nomsebenzi OHLUKILEYO (umzekelo umsebenzi wasekhaya, ukucoca okanye incwadi). Isivakalisi 1: akukho nxalenye uyenzileyo yomsebenzi wokuqala. Isivakalisi 2: wenze inxalenye kuphela yomsebenzi wesibini. Musa ukusebenzisa '다 안' okanye '다 못' kwesinye isivakalisi.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi'akukho', khetha igama elithetha 'hayi nokuba linye'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwi'nxalenye', chaza ukuba wenze kangakanani (isiqingatha, kancinci, ukuya kuthi ga kwindawo ethile) okanye sebenzisa isimbo esithetha 'hayi yonke'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba isivakalisi sam ngasinye sinokufundwa ngendlela enye kuphela?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba izivakalisi ezimbini ziyazichaza ngokwenene izixa ezahlukileyo?

n-k-k6-04.title: Ngaba isishwankathelo siyahambelana nengxelo?
n-k-k6-04.topic: Ukushwankathela uphando ngokuthembekileyo: oko ingxelo ikuxhasayo
n-k-k6-04.goal: Thelekisa isishwankathelo seblogi somfundi nabo ngengxelo yephephandaba lesikolo, ufumane imigca engaxhaswanga yingxelo, ulungise omnye wayo.
n-k-k6-04.material:
Iphephandaba lesikolo liprinte ingxelo emfutshane. 하준 uyishwankathele kwiblogi yeklasi komnye umhlobo ongakwaziyo ukufunda iphephandaba.

[학교 신문: 급식 설문 결과]
- 조사 대상: 6학년 2반 학생 24명 (6학년은 모두 다섯 반입니다.)
- 18명은 "급식이 맛있다", 6명은 "보통이다"라고 답했습니다. "맛없다"고 답한 학생은 없었습니다.
- 급식을 남기지 않는 학생은 14명이었습니다.
n-k-k6-04.thinking.2: Ukubhala kwakhona umgca ukuze uhambelane nobungqina bawo
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.prompt: Thelekisa isishwankathelo sika-하준 nengxelo. Khetha umgca omnye wesishwankathelo ONGAXHASWANGA yingxelo. (Ngaphezu komgca omnye awulunganga.)
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha isishwankathelo umgca ngomgca ufumane isivakalisi singxelo esivela kuso.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, thelekisa abafundi amanani engxelo abhekisele kubo nabafundi umgca owuthethayo ngabo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.explain: Imigca 2, 4 kunye no-6 ayilunganga. Ingxelo ibuze kuphela abafundi aba-24 be-6학년 2반, ngoko ayithethi nto ngabo bonke abafundi bebanga lesithandathu, amanye amaklasi okanye isikolo sonke. Imigca 1, 3 kunye no-5 imalunga neklasi leyo kwaye ihambelana nengxelo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.prompt: Imigca engalunganga inento enye ekhoyo ngokufanayo. Yiluphi uhlobo lwempazamo?
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye owukhethileyo, yithi ingxelo imalunga nabaphi abafundi nomgca umalunga nabaphi abafundi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela into eyabelwana yiyo imigca emithathu xa uthelekisa ezo ngqokelela zibini.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.a: Amanani 24 kunye no-14 esishwankathelweni afana nawo engxelweni.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.b: Into eyaziwayo ngeklasi enye yathethwa ngeqela elikhulu.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.c: Izigqibo ezingahloniphekanga ziqhelekile kwisishwankathelo somhlobo kwaye asiyiyo impazamo malunga nomxholo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.d: Imigca engalunganga yongeza izibakala; ayishiyi ziphumo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.explain: Ingxelo imalunga nabafundi aba-24 kwiklasi enye. Imigca engalunganga yolula eso siphumo ibe kubo bonke abafundi bebanga lesithandathu, kumanye amaklasi, okanye kwisikolo sonke, into engazange ichazwe yingxelo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kwakhona umgca wokugqibela wesishwankathelo (malunga nokungashiyi kutya) ukuze uthi kuphela oko ingxelo ikutshoyo (intetho engahloniphekanga komhlobo wakho ilungile).
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana isivakalisi singxelo esivela kuso lo mgca uphawule ngqo ukuba ubhekisa kubani nangaphi.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala kwakhona umgca usebenzisa elo qela kunye nelo nani kuphela.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umgca wam uyaliqamba iqela elibuzwe yingxelo?
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ndilugcinile inani njengoko ingxelo isinika lona, ndingalijikeleza libe 'uninzi' okanye 'bonke'?

n-k-k6-01.title: Ukufunda amanani ethala leencwadi
n-k-k6-01.topic: Ukuvavanya izibhengezo nobungqina: oko itheyibhile yamanani inokukubonisa
n-k-k6-01.goal: Gqiba ukuba ziziphi izibhengezo itheyibhile encinci yamanani ethala leencwadi ezixhasayo ngokwenene, ufumane isithuba phakathi kwesihloko seposta netheyibhile, uze usichaze ngenani.
n-k-k6-01.material:
Ithala leencwadi lommandla lamisa itheyibhile neposta.

[우리 동네 도서관 3월 이용 현황]
구분 | 작년 3월 | 올해 3월
이용자 수 | 2,400명 | 3,000명
빌려 간 책 | 5,200권 | 5,100권
(올해 3월부터 1층에 무료 공부방을 열었습니다.)

[포스터]
"도서관 덕분에 우리 동네 사람들이 책을 더 많이 읽게 되었습니다!"
n-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko itheyibhile ikubalayo koko isibhengezo sikuthethayo
n-k-k6-01.prereq.1: Uyazi 늘다 / 줄다 kunye ne-작년 / 올해
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Ziziphi izibhengezo itheyibhile ngokwayo ezixhasayo, ngaphandle kokuqikelela? Khetha zonke ezifanelekileyo.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Phawula isibhengezo ngasinye njengo-'inani endinokulikhomba' okanye 'into endiya kufuneka ndiyiqikelele'.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwizibhengezo ngamanani, fumana amanani amabini uwathelekise kwicala elichanekileyo.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukuthanda iincwadi yimvakalelo; itheyibhile ibala utyelelo neencwadi ezibolekiweyo, hayi iimvakalelo.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: Thelekisa kwakhona i-5,200 ne-5,100: inani leencwadi ezibolekiweyo lihambe ngecala elichasene.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Itheyibhile idwelisa igumbi lokufunda njengenqaku elingaphandle kuphela; ayibonisi ukuba igumbi sisizathu sokunyuka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Itheyibhile ibonisa abatyeleli abangama-2,400 ukuya kwama-3,000 (ngakumbi) neencwadi ezibolekiweyo ezingama-5,200 ukuya kwezingama-5,100 (kancinane ngaphantsi). Iimvakalelo nezizathu azikho kwitheyibhile, kwaye 'iincwadi ezininzi' yichasene noko ibonisa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: Sesiphi esona sithuba siphambili phakathi kwesihloko seposta netheyibhile?
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ngokubeka umgca kwisenzi sesihloko seposta, uze ufumane umgca kwitheyibhile elinganisa into enye.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa oko umgca ngamnye wetheyibhile ukubalayo nalokho isihloko sisithi abantu bakwenzile.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.a: Iposta ithetha ngonyaka ophelileyo, kodwa itheyibhile ibonisa lo nyaka kuphela.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.a: Itheyibhile inecandelo lonyaka ophelileyo nelalo nyaka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.b: Iposta ithi abantu bafunda ngakumbi, kodwa itheyibhile ibonisa abatyeleli abambalwa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.b: Itheyibhile ibonisa abatyeleli abaninzi, hayi abambalwa.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.c: Iposta ichanekile, kuba ithala leencwadi elixakekileyo lithetha ukufunda okungakumbi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.c: Abatyeleli abaninzi akufani nokufunda okungakumbi: abantu bangeza ngezinye izizathu, kwaye inani lemboleko alikhulanga.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.d: Iposta ithetha ngokufunda, kodwa itheyibhile ibala utyelelo nemboleko, kwaye imboleko ayinyukanga.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.explain: 'Ukufunda ngakumbi' asiyiyo into etheyibhile ebala. Esona silinganiselo sisondeleyo yiincwadi ezibolekiweyo, kwaye ayinyukanga. Abatyeleli abaninzi basenokuba sisiphumo segumbi elitsha lokufunda, kodwa itheyibhile ayinakuthi.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.prompt: Kwizivakalisi ezi-1-2 (isiNgesi okanye isiKorea), thi ingaba itheyibhile iyaxhasa isihloko seposta nokuba kutheni. Sebenzisa ubuncinane inani elinye lisuka kwitheyibhile.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.0: Chaza umgca wetheyibhile osondele kakhulu ku-'ukufunda', unike amanani awo amabini.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko thi ngumgca ongakubonisi ntoni malunga nesihloko seposta.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndithe itheyibhile ilinganisa ntoni nokuba iposta ibanga ntoni?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Inani lam lisebenza njengobungqina, hayi ukukopa nje?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.model.0: Itheyibhile ibonisa abatyeleli abaninzi (2,400 ukuya kwi-3,000), kodwa iincwadi ezibolekiweyo zehle ukusuka kwi-5,200 ukuya kwi-5,100, ngoko ayibonisi ukuba abantu bafunda ngakumbi.

n-k-k6-03.title: Ingaba ikhuphoni yanele ukugqiba?
n-k-k6-03.topic: Ukwanela kolwazi: oko ikhuphoni ikuchazayo noko ikushiya kuvuliwe
n-k-k6-03.goal: Hlula oko ikhuphoni isele iphendula koko ikushiya kuvuliwe, uze uphendule umhlobo ulungisa inqaku elinye ubuze ngelivuliweyo.
n-k-k6-03.material:
Namhlanje ngoMvulo, 4월 27일. Umhlobo wakho 민아 ukuthumelela umyalezo nekhuphoni.

민아: 나 카페 쿠폰 받았어! 이번 주 목요일 수업 끝나고 세 시쯤 학교 앞 모아카페에 가자. 아메리카노 두 잔 시키면 쿠폰으로 4,000원 할인받을 수 있어!

[아메리카노 2,000원 할인 쿠폰]
- 유효 기간: 4월 30일까지
- 사용 매장: 모아카페 전 지점
- 1회 사용 (쿠폰 한 장당)
- 다른 할인과 중복 불가
- 그 밖의 조건은 앱에서 확인하세요.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.prompt: Ukuba ulandela icebo luka-민아 usebenzisa le khuphoni inye kwiiAmericano ezimbini ngoLwesine, sisiphi isivakalisi esiyinyani?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Vavanya olunye ukhetho ngalunye ngokuchasene nemigca eprintiweyo yekhuphoni: yintoni onokuyiqinisekisa kwaye yintoni onokuyichasa?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba icebo liya kuxabisa malini nangaphandle kwekhuphoni, usebenzisa kuphela oko kuchazwe yikhuphoni.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.a: Ikhuphoni iphelelwe lixesha ngoLwesine, ngoko akukho nto yokuncitshiswa kwexabiso.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.a: NgoLwesine yi-30 kuTshazimpuzi, kwaye '4월 30일까지' ibandakanya olo suku.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.b: Ikhuphoni ikhupha i-2,000 won kwisiselo ngasinye, ngoko i-4,000 ilonke.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.b: '1회 사용' kuthetha ukusetyenziswa kube kanye kwikhuphoni nganye, hayi kube kanye kwisiselo ngasinye.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukongeza esinye isaphulelo kwenza ukonga kube kukhulu ngaphezu kwe-2,000 won.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.c: '다른 할인과 중복 불가' kuthetha ukuba izaphulelo azinakudityaniswa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.d: Ikhuphoni enye ikhupha i-2,000 won kube kanye, hayi i-4,000.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.explain: Namhla yiMivulo yile-27, ngoko ke uLwesine yi-30, usuku lokugqibela olusebenzayo. Ikhuphoni yokusetyenziswa kube kanye kwaye ayinakudityaniswa, ngoko iziselo ezimbini zisakhupha i-2,000 won ilonke.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.prompt: Icebo kukuba kube nguLwesine malunga nentsimbi yesi-3 emva kwemini kwikhefi ephambi kwesikolo. Yeyiphi imibuzo engaphenduleki yikhuphoni nenokuthi ilumke icebo?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kumbuzo ngamnye, khangela umgca wekhuphoni oyiphendulayo; sika ezo unokuziphendula.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yeyiphi inxalenye yecebo engagutyungelwa nangumgca ofanayo oprintiweyo?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.a: Ikhuphoni isinike usuku lokugqibela olusebenzayo, kwaye uLwesine uyahambelana nalo.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.b: Ikhuphoni isitshilo ukuba isetyenziswa kube kanye kwikhuphoni nganye.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.d: Ikhuphoni isitshilo ukuba isebenza kwisebe ngalinye le-모아카페.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.explain: Usuku, inani lokusetyenziswa namasebe ziprintiwe kwikhuphoni. Umgca wokugqibela ushiya 'ezinye iimeko' zivulekile, kwaye ixesha losuku lelinokubalulekileyo ekuzeni ngentsimbi yesi-3 emva kwemini.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.prompt: Phendula 민아 ngesiKorean (isimbo esithandekayo se-해요체). Lungisa ngobunono ingcamango ye-4,000 won, ucele okanye ucebise ukuba kuhlolwe umbuzo ovulekileyo.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala iinxalenye ezimbini ezimfutshane: oko ukwaziyo kwikhuphoni, emva koko oko ufuna ukukufumanisa.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa isigqibo esicebisayo okanye esibuzayo, njenge '-(으)ㄹ까요?'.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ndithe ikhuphoni inika ntoni inyani (isaphulelo esinye se-2,000 won)?
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba umbuzo wam ngalo nto inye ayithethi ikhuphoni?
